Package index

Package Overview

stablr stablr-package
stablr: Sparse and Reliable Biomarker Discovery in R

Getting started

The one-stop-shop entry point for new users — a data.frame in, a plain-language selection out.

stabl()
STABL Stability Selection (Beginner Interface)
print(<stabl>)
Print a Fitted STABL Object (Beginner Style)
summary(<stabl>)
Summarize a Fitted STABL Object (Beginner Style)
plot(<stabl>)
Plot Stability Paths for a Fitted STABL Object (Beginner Style)
support() feature_names()
Support and Feature Names of a STABL Selection

Core STABL Engine

Fit single-matrix STABL selectors and compute FDP+ thresholds (expert interface).

stabl_fit() print(<stabl_fit>)
Fit STABL (Stability-Penalized Feature Selection)
auto_lambda_grid()
Build a Data-Driven Lambda Grid
compute_fdp_plus()
Compute FDP+ (False Discovery Proportion Upper Bound)

Knockoff Feature Construction

Factories that inject artificial features (Model-X knockoffs or random permutations) for FDP+ calibration; plug into stabl_fit through the knockoff/solver arguments.

make_knockoff_features()
Make Knockoff Artificial Features
make_knockoff_equi_features()
Make Model-X Equicorrelated Knockoff Artificial Features
make_knockoff_mvr_features()
Make Model-X MVR Knockoff Artificial Features
make_rp_features()
Make Random-Permutation Artificial Features

Learner Adapters

Public learner factories for glmnet-family and sparse-group backends.

make_glmnet_adapter()
Build a glmnet Learner Adapter
make_adaptive_lasso_adapter()
Build an Adaptive Lasso Learner Adapter
make_sgl_adapter()
Build a Sparse Group Lasso Learner Adapter

Extended Learner Adapters

Extensions beyond the glmnet family. The random forest is calibrated within a measured scope (WS-2); the oblique forest is fenced (WS-3); the ordinal learner is experimental (WS-9); sPLS-DA is experimental and binomial-only.

make_ranger_adapter()
Build a Random-Forest Learner Adapter (Calibrated, Scoped)
auto_rf_threshold_grid()
Auto-Generate an Importance-Threshold Grid for Random-Forest STABL (Experimental)
make_aorsf_adapter()
Build an Oblique Random-Forest Learner Adapter (Fenced)
auto_oblique_threshold_grid()
Auto-Generate an Importance-Threshold Grid for Oblique-Random-Forest STABL (Experimental)
make_ordinal_adapter()
Build an Ordinal-Regression Learner Adapter (Experimental)
auto_ordinal_lambda_grid()
Build a Data-Driven Lambda Grid for the Ordinal Learner (Experimental)
make_splsda_adapter()
Build a sPLS-DA Learner Adapter
auto_splsda_keepx_grid()
Build an Automatic keepX Grid for the sPLS-DA Learner

Environment Stability

ICP-inspired transportability workflow across environments (batches, cohorts, sites); promoted with a documented scope after the WS-5 transportability benchmark (min-aggregation is the calibrated read).

stabl_environment_stability()
Environment-Stability Workflow: Reliable and Transportable Feature Sets
get_min_scores()
Get Minimum-Across-Environment Stability Scores
print(<stabl_env_stability>)
Print an Environment-Stability Analysis

Decoy-feature generation for FDP+ calibration.

make_artificial_features()
Dispatcher for Artificial Feature Generation

Analysis Workflow

Explicit exploratory/validated analysis with canonical evidence tables and fold-safe preprocessing.

stabl_analyze() print(<stabl_analysis>) summary(<stabl_analysis>)
STABL analysis with an explicit evidence mode
stabl_interpret()
Interpret a fitted STABL selection
stabl_preprocess_fit()
Fit a fold-safe preprocessing transform on training data
stabl_preprocess_apply()
Apply a fitted preprocessing transform
stabl_preprocess_fit_recipes()
Fit a preprocessing transform from a recipes recipe

Deprecated names

Old names kept as deprecation shims; they warn once and delegate to the replacements above.

jaccard_matrix()
Deprecated: use jaccard_similarity_matrix()
adjusted_similarity_values()
Deprecated: use adjusted_similarity_pairwise()
adjusted_similarity_measure()
Deprecated: use adjusted_similarity_summary()
pearson_similarity_values()
Deprecated: use pearson_similarity_pairwise()
pearson_similarity_measure()
Deprecated: use pearson_similarity_summary()
get_feature_names_out()
Deprecated: use get_feature_names()
classic_bootstrap_indices()
Deprecated: use sample_bootstrap_indices()
stacked_multi_omic()
Deprecated: use stabl_multiomic_stacked()
